name: Albertosuchus
sum: Albertosuchus is a crocodyloid crocodylian from the Maastrichtian Scollard Formation of Alberta, the northernmost known Late Cretaceous crocodyloid.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Scollard Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
